description: This script orchestrates running the 'oxlint' tool with specific policies and locking mechanisms. It handles configuration, process spawning, error handling, and lock management for maintaining a controlled environment during linting.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Applies custom linting policies to the command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Acquires a lock to ensure exclusive access during the linting process.
